cross_cutting.title: add_vrect / add_hrect shapes composite ABOVE the data traces
cross_cutting.detail: Plotly shapes default to layer='above'; none of the eight add_vrect/add_hrect calls in the four D11 figure functions overrides it. Every marker and curve inside a shaded region is therefore alpha-blended with the shading. Confirmed arithmetically to the unit on all three colour channels: Fig 3 markers 0.8*(230,57,70) + 0.2*(46,134,171) = (193,72,90) measured; Fig 4 marker 0.86*carmine + 0.14*steel_blue = (204,68,84) predicted vs (203,67,84) measured; Fig 1 markers 0.8*carmine + 0.2*amber = (232,74,56), 543 px measured. Effects: (a) semantically identical certified points render in different colours (Fig 3 m=5 vs m=6; Fig 4 left vs right); (b) a legend swatch does not match its own marker (Fig 4); (c) a single continuous curve changes colour mid-trace (Fig 3 left panel, K' branch (201,141,34) inside vs (241,143,1) outside). It is invisible in Fig 2 only because that vrect is steel blue over steel-blue curves — a no-op — not because the figure is correct.
cross_cutting.fix: Add layer='below' to every add_vrect / add_hrect in fig_d11_phononic_band_gap, fig_d11_pt_exceptional_point, fig_d11_haldane_chern and fig_d11_effective_medium. The D12 figure functions share this idiom and should be swept in the same pass.

cross_cutting.detail: The PNG filenames and baked-in titles number Haldane = 3 and effective-medium = 4, but paper_draft.tex orders the sections Phononic, Non-Hermitian, Effective-medium, Graphene, so paper_draft.aux resolves fig:effmedium -> Figure 3 and fig:haldane -> Figure 4. Minimal: swap the two numerals and filenames, or reorder the two \begin{figure} blocks.

cross_cutting.title: The D11 figures have no harness coverage at all
cross_cutting.detail: scripts/review_figures.py's FIGURE_REGISTRY contains no fig_d11_* entry; figures/review_manifest.json and figures/structural_checks.json each contain ZERO occurrences of 'd11'; and nothing under scripts/ or tests/ references fig_d11_* or papers/D11/figures. These four PNGs are therefore generated out-of-band, have no manifest describing expected traces/labels, and have no structural or regression check. This is the direct reason XC-A and XC-B survived a full review round: no automated gate could see them. Round-1 recommendation P3 (bbox-intersection check) was also not implemented.
cross_cutting.fix: Register the four fig_d11_* functions in FIGURE_REGISTRY with output_dir papers/D11/figures, so they get a manifest entry and participate in run_structural_checks(). Then add two checks that would have caught this round's FAILs: (1) assert every layout shape carries an explicit layer, flagging layer='above' over data; (2) assert that in-image title text of the form 'Fig. N' agrees with the figure's ordinal in its consumer .tex.

summary: Round 2 verifies that the three round-1 FAILs are genuinely fixed: the systemic axis-title/legend overprint is gone from Figs 1 and 2 (though only Figs 3 and 4 actually route through the new _d12_layout() helper — Figs 1/2 inline an equivalent block), and Fig 3's silently-clipped vrect annotation is replaced by a legend-visible entry so the shaded window is explained. Remediations 3, 4, 5, 6 and the Fig-4 half of 8 landed cleanly and close five round-1 findings including two bundle anchors. The physics was fully recomputed from scratch this round and is exact on every anchor — gap edges 1 and 2 attained at k = ±π with an empty gap over 200k samples; EP at g = 1 with Δ = 0 and Δ = 1/5 exactly at g² = 99/100; C = −1 at m = 1 and C = 0 at m = 5 and m = 6 against the actual Lean statements, with 3√3 = 5.196152 and m = 5 correctly inside the window; Maxwell–Garnett (1,4,1/2) = 2 exactly and the Voigt–Reuss gap = 1 exactly at f = 2/3. The bundle nevertheless does NOT meet the ALL-PASS criterion. Two NEW defects were found, both invisible to round 1: (XC-A) all eight add_vrect/add_hrect calls composite ABOVE the traces, so shading recolours the certified data markers — confirmed to the unit on every colour channel — which defeats remediation 7 by making m = 5 and m = 6 different reds and by desynchronising Fig 4's legend swatch from its own marker; and (XC-B) the in-image figure numbers contradict the compiled document, because paper_draft.tex places the effective-medium figure before the Haldane figure, so the PDF prints 'Figure 3' under an image titled 'D11 Fig. 4' and vice versa, with the in-text cross-reference at line 360 pointing the reader at the wrong numeral. Five round-1 MINORs survive entirely unfixed — Fig 2's unresolvable proximity enclosure, Fig 3's flip line bisecting the '5' of its own m = 5 label, and Fig 4's ASCII underscores, panel-filling bounds shading and interleaved legend. The root cause of the survival is XC-C: the D11 figures are absent from FIGURE_REGISTRY, review_manifest.json and structural_checks.json, so no automated gate covers them.
recommendations: P0 — XC-A: add layer='below' to all eight add_vrect/add_hrect calls in the four fig_d11_* functions. One-line-per-call change; fixes the FAIL on Figs 1, 3 and 4 and restores remediation 7.
